gen-dafont-dogica-plus-jakarta-sans: Chunky, wide-spaced and loud. Dogica's lowercase climbs nearly to cap height, while Plus Jakarta Sans stays modern and precise beneath it, with a lower, monoline build and curve ends kept well apart.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-amulya: Early GameBoy stretches its letters wide with sturdy hairlines. Amulya, a contemporary sans with generous gaps in its curves, has a much lower lowercase, so a bigger heading size makes sense.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and loose, like spaghetti laid out in letters. Early GameBoy towers above it with a skyward lowercase and commanding, wide tracking, while the body's lower, hairline-free strokes keep things relaxed.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-plein: Blocky, playful and wide-set, with gentle swelling along its curves. Plein follows as a plain sans with a clear channel into each round letter, and its low lowercase gives the heading plenty of room to shout.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans draws every stem, bowl and tail with rope-like consistency, leaving wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Early GameBoy's modest weight shifts feel livelier beside it, so give the heading extra size.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-synonym: Pixel-bright and cheeky, with strokes that differ just enough to feel alive. Synonym sits below as a dependable sans, its curves and straights sharing one width, and its lower lowercase lets the heading tower.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif brings a literary, refined voice, with a low, outsized lowercase. Early GameBoy's modest weight shifts and commanding stretch stand clearly apart from it, so a larger heading size would help.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-port-lligat-: Wide, skyward lowercase gives Early GameBoy its playful swagger. Port Lligat Slab answers underneath with porthole-round counters and hugging letters, a traditional serif that grounds the heading's tempered modulation.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-quando: Early GameBoy stretches wide with a skyward lowercase and a playful, commanding stance. Quando, bookish and widely spaced, brings a tall middle zone and low contrast, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-outfit: Outfit bends its strokes like cable, with no swelling or thinning and curves that finish before they close. And Early GameBoy, tall and widely tracked, gives that smooth body a playful, commanding header.
